summary: Bug fix verification completed for Clara radio management tool. 3 bugs tested: 1) Site admin WordPress access - FIXED and verified 2) 'Geen toegang' message instead of redirect - FIXED (found bug in TeamSettingsPage loading state) 3) WordPress category sync - Backend tests pass, skipped actual sync test (no WP sites in DBNT).

frontend_tests.eddy_login_success: PASS - Eddy Thijs logged in, sees site selector with presenter role on Radiogroep, admin role on DBNT
frontend_tests.wordpress_page_dbnt_site_admin: PASS - WordPress Sites page loads correctly for Eddy (site admin on DBNT)
frontend_tests.wordpress_page_radiogroep_presenter: PASS - 'Geen toegang' message displayed for Eddy (presenter on Radiogroep)
frontend_tests.team_settings_dbnt_site_admin: PASS - Site Settings page loads correctly for Eddy on DBNT
frontend_tests.team_settings_radiogroep_presenter: PASS - 'Geen toegang' message displayed for Eddy on Radiogroep (after fix)
frontend_tests.network_admin_wordpress_access: PASS - Network admin can access WordPress settings

bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.issue: Loading state never set to false when user doesn't have admin access, causing infinite loading spinner instead of 'Geen toegang' message
bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.fix: Added setLoading(false) before returning early when !isMainSiteAdmin

critical_code_review_comments: WordPressSettingsPage correctly uses useMainSite() for site-specific admin check
Backend WordPress endpoints correctly use get_effective_role() instead of require_admin
Category sync endpoint removes stale categories that no longer exist in WordPress

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 tests passed, 2 skipped due to no WP sites)

seed_data_creation: Test WordPress sites created and cleaned up during backend tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 bugs are now fixed: 1) Site-specific admin access to WordPress settings works via useMainSite() context and get_effective_role() backend function 2) 'Geen toegang' message is properly displayed on both WordPressSettingsPage and TeamSettingsPage 3) Category sync with removal of stale categories is implemented. Testing agent found and fixed a bug in TeamSettingsPage where loading state was never set to false for non-admin users.
rca_of_the_issue: Bug #1 (WordPress access): The original code used global isAdmin from useAuth() instead of site-specific admin check. Fixed by using useMainSite() context. Bug #2 (Geen toegang): WordPressSettingsPage was correct, but TeamSettingsPage had a bug where setLoading(false) was never called when user doesn't have admin access, causing infinite loading skeleton. Bug #3 (Category sync): Backend now correctly removes categories that no longer exist in WordPress by tracking wp_cat_ids and deleting entries not in that list.
